ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible ventral surface, with localized high-intensity (white/yellow) pixel clusters at the distal tips and scattered white ring-shaped markings. Estimated macro ratio of 95:5 (dark to light).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation substrate across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast heterogeneous clusters (yellowish-white) at the far-left and far-right distal tips. Multiple small, high-contrast white circular and ring-shaped blobs scattered non-uniformly across the central and lower regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute-angled V-shaped notch dividing the two lobes, characterized by a narrow vertex and straight interior edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern along the trailing edge of both lobes; frequency of peaks increases towards the distal tips; pixel-amplitude of variations is more pronounced on the left lobe's upper-left boundary compared to the right lobe's smoother interior edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves tapering from the central notch towards the upper distal tips; the right lobe exhibits a slightly more rounded, bulbous sweep compared to the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of high-contrast white ring-shaped and circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) distributed across the dark ventral surface, predominantly in the mid-to-lower sections of the lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light grey/white) visible as diagonal and horizontal scratches, most notably on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular, high-contrast calcified masses (barnacles) at both distal tips; the right tip cluster is more vertically oriented and voluminous than the left tip cluster.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical high-intensity specular highlights and linear pixel trails extending downwards from the trailing edge and tips, corresponding to falling water droplets.
